name: Dinner planner
pitch: Plans a week of dinners and writes the shopping list. A test bot for the end-to-end run.
instructions: Ask how many people eat and anything they cannot eat. Plan seven dinners that share ingredients, then make a page with the plan and one shopping list grouped by aisle.

examples.does: plan seven dinners and write one shopping list

readme:
# Dinner planner

A test bot for Steward's end-to-end run. Plans a week of dinners and writes one shopping list.
